g.text: Pathway coherence, animal-level scores and statistical uncertainty
Complete evidence distributions under three CAMERA assumptions, with correlations and individual-mouse RNA measurements.
A: one index exposure contrast per study/pathway; bars show 10th-90th percentiles, thick bars the interquartile range, white points medians.
B/C/E/F: every planned test, including unavailable hypotheses at q=1. Y-axis scales differ. D: points are mice; horizontal bars are group means.
Estimated-correlation CAMERA also uses only 3-19 residual degrees of freedom. No conservative/estimated pathway result passes full-family correction.
